constraints: The '@' character cannot be used in folderName.
If the command detects a duplicated method name, error -9802 ("Object path not unique") is generated.

overloadMerges.note: arrPaths is filled in by the command (parameter table marks it with the '←' return arrow), so its direction should be 'out'. stamp is bidirectional (parameter table marks it with the '↔' arrow: caller passes a minimum stamp value in, command returns the new current stamp value out), so its direction should be 'inout', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

params.name: folderName
params.description: Name of Home page folder to restrict results to

params.name: methodType
params.description: Selector (or combination of selectors) of method type(s) to get, e.g. Path all objects (-1), Path project method (1), Path database method (2), Path project form (4), Path trigger (8), Path table form (16), Path class (32).

params.name: arrPaths
params.description: Array of method paths and names

params.name: stamp
params.description: In: minimum modification-counter stamp value to filter on. Out: the new current (highest) stamp value, for use in a subsequent call to get only newer/modified methods.
If passed, applies to the host database's methods when called from a component (otherwise ignored).
